text:
emma_cs: Quick heads-up — doing a 10-min account "thermal scan" for NorthStar before tomorrow's EBR. Can folks drop any red flags or slide asks here?

lia_success: love the metaphor 😂. For NorthStar: onboarding still has 2 blocked tasks (sso, dataset ingest). Slides need a clear "blockers & mitigation" card.

jordan_se: SSO blocker is a config issue on their IdP. I can join customer call at 11am PT to walk through. Add me to the troubleshooting slide.

sam_ops: dataset ingest delay due to schema mismatch — engineering ETA to resolve is EOD Thu. Recommend we add contingency: staging ingest and manual demo.

emma_cs: noted. Lia — can you own the mitigation slide text + owner list? 2 bullets max.

lia_success: Yep — I'll draft. Also want to capture renewal risk signal: usage slipped 18% last 30d and two competitors mentioned in feedback. Suggest a "risk tier" indicator on exec slide.

kevin_exec: +1 on risk tier. Keep the ask specific: what do we need from execs? (approval for extended onboarding SOW or discount?)

emma_cs: We're asking for a 1-month SOW extension (funded) to complete ingest + training. Will put ask under "recommended next steps (decision)".

jordan_se: For the slide deck, put these two items: 1) SSO troubleshooting + owner/contact (me) 2) Ingest contingency + delivery ETA (sam_ops).

deck-bot: Upload complete — "NorthStar_EBR_draft_v3.pdf" available at https://drive.redwood.ai/northstar/EBR/v3.

sam_ops: I left a short logs snippet on the drive folder: `ingest_error_2026-03-21.log`. Lia — can you add a screenshot to the ops appendix?

lia_success: will add screenshot + two feedback quotes (anonymized) about competitive mentions.

emma_cs: Also capturing customer sentiment: NPS comment flagged low adoption due to missing analytics view. Put this as a product ask (not an immediate exec ask).

kevin_exec: For the exec readout: slide order should be: health snapshot -> top 3 risks -> recommended decision -> timeline & owners. Keep it to 6 slides.

lia_success: drafting now. putting a 1-line impact metric under each risk (e.g., "usage -18% => revenue at risk ~$35k/quarter"). Need final numbers from finance if possible.

emma_cs: @kevin_exec can you confirm if finance can validate the $35k figure before noon? That will make the ask tighter.

kevin_exec: I'll ping finance now, will try to confirm by 11:45.

jordan_se: FYI — I'll be on the customer call and will capture any new asks. If anything big appears, I'll post an update here immediately.

sam_ops: tagging follow-up items for action tracker: `A-1` SSO triage (jordan_se), `A-2` ingest contingency demo (sam_ops), `A-3` mitigation slide + quotes (lia_success), `A-4` exec ask wording + financial validation (emma_cs / kevin_exec).

emma_cs: perfect. We'll include the action tracker table on the last slide. Lia, can you drop the updated deck link here when ready?

lia_success: dropping v4 in 30m -> https://drive.redwood.ai/northstar/EBR/v4 — will highlight the mitigation slide and the decision ask.

deck-bot: Noted: new upload detected "NorthStar_EBR_v4.pdf" at 1749958915.

emma_cs: thanks — last question: any critical feedback items we should surface now (not in slides) so CS lead can prep conversation tone?

jordan_se: customer said "analytics feel shallow" and "too much manual setup" in product feedback. Recommend empathetic tone and specific timeline to improve analytics in H2.

lia_success: added a "customer tone" bullet: empathetic, solutions-first, emphasize partnership and funded support window.

emma_cs: great. I'll run a 10-min dry run at 2pm PT. Invite sent. If anything changes, drop here. :thumbsup:
